correctness.rationale: The difference walk has eigenvalues (1−p+p cos θ_k)². The Fourier Dirichlet solution with value zero at 0 has numerator 1−cos(xθ_k); at separation one it cancels the corresponding factor in 1−λ_k. Aliasing the absolutely convergent Poisson series for (2−p+p cos θ)^(-1) onto multiples of n gives the signed parity factor and the k=0 subtraction −1/(2p). Summands 1/(2p−a_k p²) have positive second derivative. At p↓0 the mean diverges; at p=1 for even n parity is invariant and rules out meeting. For odd n, division by 2 mod n maps the relative walk to a half-lazy nearest-neighbor walk starting at distance coordinate (n±1)/2, with mean 2x(n−x)=(n²−1)/2. The general interior bound at p=2/3 beats this for odd n≥5; the explicit triangle mean does so for n=3. Uniformly near p₀=2/3 the closed form has exponentially small parity error (also after differentiation), giving H′=nG′+1/(2p²)+O(n²ρ^n). The derivative sign brackets the optimizer, and G″(p₀)=81√3/16 gives the stated displacement and mean with their remainders. The event T≥t is determined before tick t and independent of that tick's move count; summing its expected reward gives 2pH. Differentiating then proves strict increase and the unattained limit n−1. Independent checks solved the killed chain rationally for 3≤n≤8 at four rational probabilities each and checked n(2/3−p_n) towards 2√3/27 by derivative bisection for n through 1920. residual_risks: Both walks use independent trials with the same move probability, fixed adjacent start and endpoint-only observations. The finite computations corroborate the formulas but not strict convexity or asymptotic bounds on their own.

value.rationale: Fixed adjacent start is a natural local benchmark, distinct from a uniform-start quadratic-time search. The exact parity-sensitive formula explains an order-n optimized time and supplies a finite-size correction; the strictly conflicting movement objective shows why optimal calendar time does not optimize actual activity. The joint quantitative comparison is useful beyond the routine spectral reduction and the small-cycle examples.
residual_risks: The optimum is not asserted for arbitrary starting separation, unequal/adaptive clocks, coordination, or mid-edge meetings.
